multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The Palestinian Authority signed the Rome Statute.
Both Iran and Iraq executed people for terrorism.
The Palestinian Authority officially became a member of the International Criminal Court.
Iran is becoming a nuclear threshold state while the international community seeks to delay its nuclear capabilities.
The ICC opened a preliminary examination into the situation in Palestinian territories, paving the way for possible war crimes investigations against Israelis.
